name: file-viewer
title: File Viewer
description: A full-screen dark overlay for stored files — images with a blur-up, zoom and pan; PDFs rendered page by page with a lazily loaded pdf.js over range requests; a download card for everything else — paged with arrows, side buttons or a swipe.

meta.whenToUse: Opening stored files full screen from attachment tiles, a product's files or a gallery — images to zoom, PDFs to read, anything else to download.
meta.whenNotToUse: Video or audio playback (VideoPlayer, AudioPlayer), or a general-purpose modal (Dialog).
